sources.title: NASA Human System Risk Management Plan, JSC-66705 Rev. B

sources.title: NASA Human Health Countermeasures: Spaceflight Risks

sources.title: Bone metabolism and renal stone risk during International Space Station missions
sources.scope: ISS astronaut study of bone biochemistry and renal-stone risk; microgravity, 4- to 6-month missions, not Mars partial gravity.
sources.review_status: abstract and bibliographic record reviewed; no Mars transfer coefficient inferred

sources.title: Association of Long-Duration Spaceflight With Anterior and Posterior Ocular Structure Changes in Astronauts and Their Recovery
sources.scope: Prospective ISS cohort study of ocular structural changes over approximately six-month missions; direct microgravity evidence, not Mars surface evidence.
sources.review_status: abstract and bibliographic record reviewed; supports measurement vocabulary only, not Mars-risk prediction

sources.title: The Space Omics and Medical Atlas (SOMA) and international astronaut biobank
sources.scope: Integrated astronaut clinical, cellular and multi-omic research resource spanning several mission programs; heterogeneous mission and assay contexts.
sources.review_status: abstract and bibliographic record reviewed; data resource is a future evidence lead, not a pre-bound dataset

sources.title: Astroimmunology: the effects of spaceflight and its associated stressors on the immune system
sources.scope: Review of immune-cell, host-microbiome and viral-reactivation evidence across spaceflight and analog stressors.
sources.review_status: abstract and bibliographic record reviewed; no individual immune-risk coefficient inferred

sources.title: Assessment of Spaceflight Medical Conditions' and Treatments' Potential Impacts on Behavioral Health and Performance
sources.scope: Assessment linking spaceflight medical conditions and treatments to behavioral-health and performance domains; not a diagnostic model.
sources.review_status: abstract and bibliographic record reviewed; supports cross-domain caution only

sources.title: Impact of spaceflight stressors on behavior and cognition: A molecular, neurochemical, and neurobiological perspective
sources.scope: Review of radiation, altered gravity, isolation/confinement and sleep disruption interactions relevant to neurobehavioral performance.
sources.review_status: abstract and bibliographic record reviewed; combined-stressor evidence remains insufficient for a Mars predictor
